As lord_nougat said, it is NOT a machine gun. It is either a submachine gun or a machine pistol, depending on your choice of nomenclature. Thing is, this is not a nitpick; there is a big difference between real machine guns and guns which are simply capable of full-automatic fire. The difference is what they fire. Machine guns fire some really serious ammunition, whereas all submachine guns (and of course machine pistols) fire PISTOL ammunition. The reason they fire pistol ammunition is because it generates a lot less heat; otherwise the barrel would get so hot it would warp. And yes, the AK-47 and similar rifles can also fire on full automatic and they are also certainly not machine guns; they are referred to as assault rifles. They also fire serious ammunition (not pistol rounds but not as hairy as typical machine gun ammo either) and their barrels are hard-chromed to ameliorate the heating. Assault rifles fit somewhere in between submachine guns and true machine guns. Submachine guns are typically used in close quarters and/or where the weapon needs to be (more or less) concealed; assault rifles are generally not so suitable for close quarters and are heavier to begin with; machine guns are too big and heavy for one man to carry and use and are best suited to defending a fixed position.
